message.deep: $firstName, at such a slow pace every exhale is long. Let the tension of the whole day drift away with it.
message.balanced: $firstName, this rhythm calms you and balances your breath with your heartbeat. Breathe easy and give yourself a moment of rest.
message.energizing: $firstName, a livelier pace will give you energy. Breathe lightly, without forcing it, and slow down whenever you like.
